scope: WP03 operational preparation using five targeted primary HTML routes and the generated working agreement. No legal opinion, actual tool audit or participant collection.

sources.title: Does an organisation always need my consent to use my personal information?
sources.locator: Latest updates; Is consenting the same as agreeing to something?; What can I expect from the organisation?
sources.bounded_finding: Ordinary agreement and data-protection consent are distinct. The organisation needs a purpose-appropriate lawful basis and transparent explanation.
sources.project_application: Keep voluntary participation/recording/attribution choices separate from the controller’s recorded lawful basis. The updated page lists seven lawful bases; this pack does not select one.
sources.limitations: Public guidance, not a project-specific determination or authority to invoke scientific-research provisions. No special-category data or scientific exemption is proposed.

sources.title: A guide to controllers and processors
sources.locator: At a glance; How do you determine whether you are a controller or processor?; under-review banner
sources.bounded_finding: Actual purposes and means affect roles; contract wording alone does not settle every possible processing activity. The page is marked under review following Data (Use and Access) Act changes.
sources.project_application: Apply the generated agreement’s on-behalf role baseline and document materially different actual activity before collection. Keep JGA instructions and processor actions traceable.
sources.limitations: Not a reason to invent joint controllership or reopen agreed roles without relevant facts. Displayed19May2023 reorganisation date is not assurance all content was substantively updated then.

sources.title: What privacy information should we provide?
sources.locator: Direct and indirect collection tables: purpose/basis, recipient, retention/rights and source categories
sources.bounded_finding: The notice must match actual use, relevant recipients, retention and rights; indirect collection also needs appropriate source/category information.
sources.project_application: Prepare a layered notice using confirmed facts: commissioning/controller contact, researcher, purposes, data/categories, sources, recipients/access, retention and applicable choices/rights.
sources.limitations: This live page retains legacy EU/European-Commission wording in its transfer row. Use only its notice categories here; do not copy that row as current UK transfer advice. No final notice or rights contact is approved.

sources.title: Are we making a restricted transfer?
sources.locator: Three-step test; Why does making personal information accessible matter?; cloud services; pseudonymised personal information
sources.bounded_finding: The transfer assessment considers applicable processing, receiver and separate entity; remote access can matter even if servers remain in the UK. Pseudonymised data sent to a processor remains personal information in the described context.
sources.project_application: Record actual legal entities, tools, hosting, recipients and access locations before selecting the required route. Treat India remote access as an actual decision to assess, not as anonymisation.
sources.limitations: No particular mechanism, assessment, adequacy route or compliance result is assumed. The service agreement is not itself an IDTA. Genuine anonymisation needs a case-specific assessment; removing names or withholding a key is not an automatic workaround.

sources.title: MRS Guidelines for Business-to-Business Research, Insight and other Data Processing Activities
sources.locator: Guideline landing-page scope, revised2023Code statement, membership/binding limits and disclaimer
sources.bounded_finding: The landing page describes additional B2B best-practice guidance and distinguishes binding Code rules for members/company partners from other guidance.
sources.project_application: Use the page as professional-method context and a pointer to the full guidance; make no accreditation or membership claim.
sources.limitations: Only the landing-page original was inspected in this strand. The linked full PDF was not inspected here, and no detailed clause is attributed to it. It is not legal advice or certification of this pack.

contractual_working_baseline.retention_exceptions: Records law requires retained remain protected and unused for other purposes; JGAchoice and actualtrigger/action torecord.

decisions.title: Working contractual role and executed-copy reconciliation
decisions.existing_baseline: Generated agreement section12 already sets JGA as controller and Riseklix as processor for on-behalf participant processing. Each handles its own business/required records.
decisions.action_needed: JGA and Riseklix confirm the intended activity follows that arrangement; document any materially different role and reconcile the executed copy when available.
decisions.current_boundary: No contrary role facts or executed copy have been reviewed.
decisions.needed_by: Before different activity or identifiable collection

decisions.title: Documented instructions, purpose and lawful basis
decisions.existing_baseline: Section12 provides the purpose/scope and requires lawful documented instructions; JGA supplies participant notices.
decisions.action_needed: JGA records the applicable basis/instructions for each actual use, including report analysis/publication and any permitted licensed use; distinguish The Table feasibility and separate future contact.
decisions.current_boundary: No lawful basis, completed notice or scientific-research exemption is selected by this pack.

decisions.title: Actual tools, restricted storage and authorised access
decisions.existing_baseline: Section12 requires tools, recipients, hosting/access locations and appropriate controls to be recorded with JGA.
decisions.action_needed: Record chosen service/legal entity, account/workspace, data category, named authorised personnel by restricted reference, access countries and deletion controls. Identity/permission records stay separate from cleared analysis.
decisions.current_boundary: No cloud folder, device, platform, account, encryption state or access control has been inspected or approved.
decisions.needed_by: Before contact details or identifiable responses enter a tool

decisions.title: UK-to-India or other access/transfer route
decisions.existing_baseline: Section12 says establish/document any required safeguards/assessment before JGA-controlled data is accessible outside the UK; agreement is not an IDTA.
decisions.action_needed: Assess the actual flow and record the lawful route and referenced safeguards where required. If not ready, use the contract fallback only after JGA retains identifiers/responses and genuinely anonymises material appropriately.
decisions.current_boundary: No mechanism signed/activated or transfer compliance established. Pseudonymised respondent notes are not assumed anonymous for a processor.

decisions.title: Notice and rights/contact details
decisions.existing_baseline: Notices and lawful collection instructions are JGA’s responsibility under section12.
decisions.action_needed: Complete controller/project contact, actual purpose/basis, categories/source, recipients, access/transfer information, retention and rights handling, in a versioned participant notice.
decisions.current_boundary: No privacy contact, rights procedure, withdrawal text or publication cut-off is invented. Different bases can entail different rights.
decisions.needed_by: Before invitation/collection under the final route

decisions.title: Separate choices and permissions
decisions.existing_baseline: Section8 requires applicable permission for named quotations, employer identification and recordings; section12 records sharing limits.
decisions.action_needed: Record participation; optional recording; specific quote/text and attribution/employer permission; any permitted recontact; council recognition and prospective membership separately.
decisions.current_boundary: An introduction is not permission. No sponsor-sales access, automatic mailing list, blanket confidentiality waiver or unlimited future reuse follows.
decisions.needed_by: At the relevant activity and before publication/sharing

decisions.title: Retention and completion/termination action
decisions.existing_baseline: Section12: at JGA’s choice return or securely delete participant data within30days after completion/termination; delete technically necessary remaining backups within90days, except legally retained protected records.
decisions.action_needed: Record JGA’s choice, triggering event/date, relevant data/backup coverage, authorised owner and completion evidence in approved restricted records. Confirm JGA’s own retention and publication/change handling for the notice.
decisions.current_boundary: These are contractual timing limits, not completed deletion, a new calendar deadline, a right to keep everything for90days or a complete retention policy for JGA.
decisions.needed_by: Plan before collection; execute against the actual trigger

decisions.title: Requests, errors and incidents
decisions.existing_baseline: Section12 requires prompt forwarding of individual rights requests, breach notification without undue delay and cooperation.
decisions.action_needed: Agree the controller escalation contact and secure route; preserve minimal incident/request references and follow documented instructions.
decisions.current_boundary: No incident has occurred, deadline is calculated or regulator determination made; do not paste sensitive incident details into this public/source workspace.
